test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Complete the given sentence with an appropriate homophone from the given options.

There was no one __________ a few of my friends.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a homophone that means **"apart from" or "excluding".**
 
• The word** "except"** fits this context, indicating exclusion.
 
• Other options like** "accept", "expect"**, and "excerpt" do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct homophone is **"except".**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"There was no one except a few of my friends."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **except** – Means to exclude or leave out.
 
• **accept** – Means to receive or agree to.
 
• **expect** – Means to anticipate or look forward to.
 
• **excerpt** – Means a short extract from a text.
